status.evidence: According to the United Kingdom Companies House registry, GPSBOB LTD (Company number 11387150) is based in Ossett and holds an active company status.

claims.claim: The company reports that its core tracking devices, such as the Two-Wire 4G GPS Vehicle Tracker and the 4G OBD GPS Vehicle Tracker, connect to cellular communication networks (utilizing 4G LTE and 2G bands) to transmit global positioning coordinates to the cloud platform.

The company reports that its telematics hardware units achieve data refresh rates of every 30 seconds while a vehicle is actively in motion, and switch to automatic periodic health checks every 12 hours when the vehicle remains stationary.

GPSBob reports a hardware portfolio featuring the GV500MG 4G OBD tracking device, two-wire 4G hardwired vehicle trackers, and 4G dashcams offering plug-and-play OBD power cable setups for automated installation without technical tools, according to the company's product documentation.

GPSBob offers insurance-approved hardware additions such as Thatcham Category S5 and S7 devices, the Mongoose S5, and Casper "No Tag, No Start" vehicle immobilisers, which require installation by accredited engineers to achieve insurance compliance, as detailed on the GPSBob commercial storefront.

The company reports that its data protection policy and telematics systems are designed to adhere to the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, overseen by an appointed Data Protection Officer who authorizes all transfers outside the UK.
The company reports serving over 15,000 customers and selling more than 29,000 devices across its personal, asset, and fleet lines.
The company reports selling more than 29,000 devices and maintaining a customer base of over 15,000 customers.

GPSBob LTD operates an affiliate program that provides content creators, bloggers, and influencers with a 10% commission on referred hardware sales, according to the official GPSBob Affiliate Program landing page.
TechMonkey acts as an international distributor and support partner for GPSBob vehicle tracking and security products in Australia, as documented by the TechMonkey Partner Profile.
The company reports selling more than 29,000 devices and serving over 15,000 customers across its asset, personal, and vehicle tracking categories as stated by GPSBob.

GPSBob LTD operates out of a single physical location situated at Unit 4D, The Gateway, Silkwood Park, Ossett, Wakefield, West Yorkshire, WF5 9TJ, UK, as confirmed by its official company Terms & Conditions – GPSBob (https://gpsbob.com/pages/terms-conditions).
claims.corrected: GPSBob LTD operates out of a physical location situated at Unit 4D Fryers Way, Ossett, West Yorkshire, WF5 9TJ, as confirmed by its official company Terms & Conditions – GPSBob (https://gpsbob.com/pages/terms-conditions).

claims.claim: The company reports providing 24/7 theft tracking support specifically for its Thatcham-approved Mongoose S5 and S7 fleet tracker units, which coordinate live positioning with the police, alongside its general UK-based customer helpline, according to the GPSBob Mongoose Process (https://gpsbob.com/pages/mongoose-process) documentation.
